sections.content: To ask a friend what they like doing, use the second-person indefinite form szeretsz with an infinitive -- the same -sz ending used for most verbs in the te (you, informal) form.
The question and answer share the same infinitive (táncolni) but change only the verb ending: szeretSZ (you) becomes szeretEK (I) in the reply -- the infinitive itself never changes.
